name: Private Garden
original_name: プライベートガーデン
source:
A puzzle game where you move blocks to form an image of a guy or a girl using all the blocks. Easy as it sounds, there is little space given to move the blocks and if any block slips off the platform, you have to try again. 

[Edited from [url=http://www.densetsu.com/display.php?id=203&style=alphabetical]animedensetsu[/url]]
translation:
一款益智游戏，需要移动方块来拼出男孩或女孩的图像，且必须使用所有方块。听起来简单，但可供移动的空间很小，如果有任何方块滑出平台，就必须重新来过。

[编辑自[url=http://www.densetsu.com/display.php?id=203&style=alphabetical]animedensetsu[/url]]
